# Complete reliable PR labels and protected activation

## Summary

Complete truthful attention and lifecycle labels, preserve every authority gate, and continue all relevant PRs and resulting repairs through successful dev merge.

The companion fixture refresh is complete: `self_host` commit `bde64ba6c7026e37991397e59dda3da67eb550c5` passed prepush and [Repository Checks 39002462254](https://github.com/Karapsin/self_host/actions/runs/39002462254). Its immutable index has the supplied SHA256 `f47dc39b…132d10`. It validates retained checkpoint candidates, without approving final controller publication or deployment.

Current evidence identifies active worker `a6e713dd…`; protected attention APIs and live acceptance remain pending. No further owner clarification or companion checkout access is needed for this plan.

## Implementation and compatibility

- Preserve the existing attention feature in `.github/agent/review_control.py` and its controller integration. Retain pinned dev’s atomic policy-comment recovery, which is already present in the current source.
- Keep `attention_snapshot()`, `attention_hint()`, and `owner_attention()` as additive host interfaces. The hint table records display classification bound to the PR head and exact observed pause; it never clears holds, changes approvals, or authorizes work.
- Preserve genuine questions, vetoes, protected approval requests, and unknown/security holds as `needs-user`. Suppress a derived correction hold only when all associated current requests are positively classified as internal. Replacement pauses and stale or uncertain classifications must prevent suppression.
- Reuse the companion production classifier and reconciliation path: durable request classification → attention hint → attention-label reconciliation → exclusive work phase. Retain older-controller conservative fallback.
- Resolve conflict markers in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/GITHUB_AGENT_OPERATIONS.md`, retaining both attention-label documentation and dev’s approval-recovery documentation. Preserve restored policy-recovery tests and recover any remaining deleted provenance note.
- Replace the vague companion follow-up reference in task evidence with exact production-source, fixture, review, CI, and activation bindings. Preserve historical records and distinguish automated decisions from authenticated owner answers.
- Audit `needs-user`, `planning`, `reviewing`, `writing`, `queued`, `testing`, and `ready` across active work, waiting requests, CI, closure, and reopening. Fix demonstrated defects only; preserve unrelated labels, worker ownership, pagination, and head/state checks.

Package APIs and versions remain unchanged. Existing authority tables retain their meaning.

## Focused regression coverage

- Retain `tests/repository/owner_attention.py`, `policy_recovery.py`, and label-reconciliation coverage. Verify replacement pauses, newer vetoes, cancellations, and evidence holds survive comment lookup, reconciliation, restart, and merge attempts.
- Reuse the completed companion `test_owner_attention.py` and `test_coordinator_holds.py` coverage through actual SQLite request classification, label reconciliation, recovery, and merge refusal.
- Verify internal-only and mixed questions, multiple requests, stale/running state, renewed planning, questions without pauses, operational retries, concurrent questions, and live writers. Assert no approval creation or unintended authority/request changes.
- Cover phase transitions, CI outcomes, API failure/retry, closed/reopened PRs, and old-controller compatibility with fakes and temporary databases.
- Compare final controller source hashes against the paired fixture bindings. The current `review_control.py` hash matches validated PR #35 code6 (`e2c6bd3e…420000`). If either bound controller component changes, the coordinator refreshes immutable fixtures and paired checks before final acceptance. Documentation-only cleanup does not invalidate unchanged component bindings.

## GitHub validation and gated activation

- Publish the completed correction through the established signed workflow. Obtain fresh independent review bound to the final head, dev base, and complete task digest.
- Require final-head focused regressions, quality gates, compatibility matrix, and aggregate fast checks. Existing PR #35 checks are successful, but cover its published predecessor rather than unpublished corrections.
- Supply paired source evidence before activation; do not make fixture validation depend on activating the same proposed APIs.
- Obtain required owner exact-head protected approval, then activate the reviewed compatible controller through the established controlled rollout and isolated rehearsal. Preserve the active worker unless a separately validated runtime change is necessary.
- Verify live internal waits display their phase while remaining blocked from merge; genuine questions and approval requests display `needs-user`; phases remain exclusive. Retain exact source hashes and activation receipts.
- Continue coordinator-owned monitoring and aligned repairs until every relevant PR and resulting repair merges successfully into dev. Separate dependency-proof requirements remain intact; fixture evidence alone cannot satisfy broader activation or workspace-verification gates.

## Limits

Recorded scope choices guide this plan but grant no protected approval, credentials, veto override, or fabricated owner fact. Companion fixture work is already completed separately. This read-only session makes no edits and runs no programs, tests, or activation.
